description: Hand a pull request Odin reviewed to an organisation member, or to nobody. Its owner is responsible for the issues Odin found on it. By default the author owns it when their GitHub account is linked to a member. Requires write permission and acts as the API key creator; the owner must be a member who can act on issues, not a Viewer.

expectedOwnerUserId.description: Only change the owner if it is still this user ID (null for nobody); otherwise Odin refuses with a conflict and nothing changes.

ownerUserId.description: Organisation member user ID, or null so that nobody owns it.

provider.description: Where the pull request lives. Defaults to github.

repository.description: Repository the pull request belongs to, as Odin shows it: owner/name on GitHub and Bitbucket, org/project/repo on Azure DevOps.

name: set_pull_request_owner
title: Set a pull request's owner
